customManagers.description: The Renovate image the renovate-config workflow validates this file with.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once every check is green. platformAutomerge is off because main has no required status checks, so GitHub would merge before CI finishes.
CI never runs web-ext, so green CI says nothing about a web-ext bump.
Renovate publishes several times a day; bump the validator image weekly.
Raise an engines ceiling only after CI is green on the new major (see docs/toolchain.md); a major bump of the exact pin fails install until then.
uuid 12+ is ESM-only; pouchdb require()s it. The override only exists for pnpm audit (see docs/toolchain.md).
The minimatch override breaks multimatch 6, which web-ext default-imports; multimatch 8 fixes that. CI never runs web-ext, so hold both majors (see docs/toolchain.md).
Paired with the minimatch rule above.
